scope: Source-first metadata for candidate currency, XP, weight and broad valuation/transaction cue lines on every page of five supplied PDFs. All candidate cues remain unreviewed; this is not a semantic price transcription or absence survey.

privacy.sourceContext: private in the local raw discovery output; no source-line text, matched source phrases or page images are included here
privacy.coordinates: page/line candidate bounds are metadata; they are unions of line span boxes, not token-level regions

printedPageMap.status: used only to derive page labels; derived values are not visually read

sourcePdfs.printedPageMapping: Printed page N corresponds to PDF page N+1.

Printed pp.1–174 correspond to PDF page N+1; pp.176–238 correspond to PDF page N. Printed p.175 is missing from the supplied PDF; a separately supplied private image is available, with printing unknown, and is not published. The identity of pp.239–240 is unverified: PDF p.239 is an unnumbered sheet and PDF p.240 is the back cover.
Printed page N corresponds to PDF page N+1.
Printed page N corresponds to PDF page N+1.
Printed pp.1–82 correspond to PDF page N+1; printed p.83 is PDF page92; pp.84–91 correspond to PDF page N; pp.92–160 correspond to PDF page N+1. Printed p.83 is misplaced after p.91.

limits: The detector searches PDF text layers, not page pixels; text extraction can omit visible print or confuse OCR glyphs.
No-cue pages and empty-text pages are not negative findings and remain unreviewed.
A number beside a currency cue is only a syntactic candidate. It may be an amount, threshold, formula, treasure quantity, weight, XP-adjacent text, example, or unrelated use.
Line boxes are candidate locations, not precise amount or token highlights. Pixel review is required before claiming exact evidence bounds.
A table value whose currency appears only in a separate heading may have no per-row currency token; source-table rows and printed unit headings require separate reconciliation.
This 776-page candidate inventory does not assert that every price in the five books was detected or semantically assessed.
